DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • The Death Knight has Pillar of Frost active (if talented) and is using Obliteration
  • The Death Knight has Breath of Sindragosa active and is talented into it
  • The Death Knight uses a build without Obliteration or Breath of Sindragosa, and either has Pillar of Frost active or does not talent into it
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • Gargoyle is active and has ≤22 seconds remaining
  • They’re using Army of the Dead: Abomination is active with <18 seconds remaining or Army Ghouls have ≤18 seconds remaining
  • They skipped Gargoyle/Army of the Dead talents and Dark Transformation is active
  • Gargoyle isn’t active and isn’t available again within 10 seconds of Power Infusion’s duration
  • 3+ enemies are present and Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is damaging enemies
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They activate Metamorphosis to amplify their burst damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds to ensure the cooldown is fully utilized before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their major offensive cooldowns Celestial Alignment or Convoke the Spirits are active or about to be activated.
  • They are in a coordinated burst window during the combat opener to align with their highest damage potential.
  • Their rotation aligns with a 2-minute cooldown cycle, syncing with your Power Infusion's availability.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid has an active Bloodlust/Heroism effect (buff.bs_inc in APL terms).
  • The Feral Druid does NOT have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent selected.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • They have Dragonrage active and one of the following is true: their Shattering Star is on cooldown, enemies are affected by the Shattering Star debuff, or there are 2+ active enemies.
  • The encounter will end in under 35 seconds (to avoid holding the cooldown).
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The Hunter is in Trueshot with over 12 seconds remaining on its duration
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Their Coordinated Assault buff is active.
  • They do NOT have Coordinated Assault and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • They have neither Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talents selected.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They do not have Spymaster's Web equipped and just cast Arcane Surge.
  • They have Spymaster's Web equipped and just cast Evocation.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active on them, and any of these conditions are met:
  • Their Combustion cooldown is almost ready (within their pre-cast timing window).
  • Their current Combustion buff has over 7 seconds remaining (to maximize burst synergy).
  • The encounter will end in under 20 seconds (to secure a final usage).
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • The Mage does not have Power Infusion active and is entering a major damage phase (e.g., cooldowns like Icy Veins or Rune of Power are active).
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is summoned and active, and one of the following is true:
  • Bloodlust is not active, or
  • Bloodlust is active while Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They activate Avenging Wrath, their primary damage-boosting cooldown
  • They activate Crusade (if talented), during its stacking haste and damage buff window
  • A target is affected by their Execution Sentence debuff, amplifying its final burst damage
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform and do not currently have Power Infusion active.
  • They activate Dark Ascension and do not currently have Power Infusion active.
  • Their Tier 30 (The War Within) 4-piece set bonus effect is active and they do not have Power Infusion active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Their Deathmark damage-over-time effect is currently active, as this maximizes bursting phases amplified by your cooldown.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance, as this amplifies their burst window with empowered stealth abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They activate Ascendance, aligning with their major damage window.
  • Ascendance is unavailable for over 30 seconds, ensuring minimal cooldown overlap.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance is active, Feral Spirit is summoned, or Doom Winds is active.
  • The fight will end within 20 seconds of a 2-minute window (e.g., 3:40 remaining in a 4-minute encounter).
  • The Shaman’s key cooldowns are unavailable for at least 2 minutes, making immediate use optimal.
  • The Shaman has not selected Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds in their talent build.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • the Warlock has activated their major cooldowns (such as Summon Darkglare) to ensure maximum damage amplification during their burst phase.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Their Wild Imps are about to despawn within 2 global cooldowns + Summon Demonic Tyrant cast time, and
  • They just cast Hand of Gul’dan or Ruination, and
  • Wild Imps will despawn before the next global cooldown after their Summon Demonic Tyrant finishes casting.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Infernal is currently active.
  • They do not have the Summon Infernal talent.
  • The encounter will end before their Summon Infernal cooldown resets plus 30 seconds (while allowing full Power Infusion duration).
  • The fight's remaining duration is less than 15 seconds after Summon Infernal would become available.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target AND the combat duration exceeds 135 seconds remaining
  • They enter the Execute phase (target ≤20% HP) AND Avatar is active
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds or less
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has more than 15 seconds remaining, and the fight duration is at least 135 seconds.
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns.
